tests.title: parses the type option, its shorthand and constants into frozen steps and refuses everything else
computes (h + top) / 2 and refuses the empty bottom link and the chroma over-read heights
copies alternate rows of every plane into owned tight planes from padded input without mutating it
rejects budgets, malformed storage, mismatched sizes, bad time bases and cancellation explicitly
matches native field across every table format, both types, heights and the chained scopes on linear graph actor and timed paths
matches native replayed field streams with a second branch and geometry propagated into vstack
matches native two-input field streams in rawvideo and framecrc through the multi-input CLI
refuses bottom fields of one-row inputs and of subsampled chroma at h % 4 == 2 before opening any output on every path
all 8 registry tests (unchanged file, field examples on all five paths)

details: 3136 byte-exact rawvideo/framecrc comparisons: 784 cases (14 formats x heights {3,5,7,8,9,12} x top/bottom forms plus field,hflip and scale=8:10,field / scale=8:12,field=bottom chains at h=7, x rawvideo and framecrc) on each of linear (-vf), graph (-filter_complex), actor (timed backend activation scheduler) and timed (pull scheduler)
98 replay-stream (createReplayVideoExecution) rawvideo comparisons with split/vstack and scale chains, timestamps checked
20 multi-input CLI (stream path) output comparisons, rawvideo and framecrc
6 native runs confirming native accepts the 6 refused inputs (h==1 bottom; bottom with subsampled chroma at h%4==2), refused here on 4 paths each (24 checks)

unsupported: type values other than top, bottom, 0, 1; option expressions
bottom on h==1 (native emits a zero-height link) - refused
bottom with yuv420p/yuva420p/nv12/nv21 at h%4==2 (native reads one chroma row past the plane) - refused
zero-frame H.264/MP4 framecrc output is not claimed (mp4-h264.ts derives SAR by operator name)

notes: No shared edits beyond the two registry lines were needed.
Setup durations: submodule init 47s, npm ci 8s, reference:build 200s, baseline checks + unit suite 150s.
Baseline typecheck, lint and boundaries were clean; unit failures are the known FLAC artifact and resample-checkpoint (macOS digest) ones, identical before and after.
The two native-accepted bottom cases are refused deliberately; native outputs for them are degenerate (zero-height) or read out of bounds.
